title: Marketplace input validation and price-grade persistence
status: source repair and mocked unit checks pass; capability not accepted
changes: Listing create/update, price observations, and order quantities/prices reject non-finite and non-positive numeric values before writes.
Price observations now persist the supplied quality_grade instead of returning an unpersisted value.
Listing creation requires a positive price, matching the canonical market_listing.price_per_unit NOT NULL schema contract.
Removed an unused historical-yield query from listing evaluation; the values were not included in its score or response.

verification.ruff: python3 -m ruff check services/analytics/marketplace.py tests/test_marketplace.py: passed

scope_limits: The unit tests use mocked database connections; no database or external provider was contacted.
Market order lifecycle, account custody, concurrent inventory reservation, cooperative order behavior, external/populated parity, and tenant authorization remain unassessed.
